origin.description: Approximate string matching equivalents of R's native match and %in%.
origin.usage: amatch(x, table, nomatch = NA_integer_, matchNA = TRUE, method = c("osa", "lv", "dl", "hamming", "lcs", "qgram", "cosine", "jaccard", "jw", "soundex"), useBytes = FALSE, weight = c(d = 1, i = 1, s = 1, t = 1), maxDist = 0.1, q = 1, p = 0, bt = 0, nthread = getOption("sd_num_thread"))

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Elements to be approximately matched; coerced to character.

arguments.name: table
arguments.text: Lookup table for matching; coerced to character.

arguments.name: nomatch
arguments.text: Value returned when no match is found; coerced to integer.

arguments.name: matchNA
arguments.text: When true, NA in x matches NA in table like base match.

arguments.name: method
arguments.text: Matching algorithm; see stringdist-metrics.

arguments.name: useBytes
arguments.text: Perform byte-wise comparison.

arguments.name: weight
arguments.text: Edit weights for osa, dl, lv, or jw.

arguments.name: maxDist
arguments.text: Maximum distance for a match; must be positive.

arguments.name: q
arguments.text: q-gram size for qgram, cosine, and jaccard.

arguments.name: p
arguments.text: Jaro-Winkler prefix factor when method is jw.

arguments.name: bt
arguments.text: Winkler boost threshold for jw.

arguments.name: nthread
arguments.text: Threads for the C code; checked and unused in Python.

origin.details: NA is matched with NA by default, like base match. Set matchNA=FALSE to return nomatch when x is missing. When several table entries tie at the smallest distance, the first is returned.
origin.value: An integer vector of length length(x) giving the position of the closest match in table (1-based), or nomatch when none is within maxDist.

translation.description: Approximate string matching equivalent of R match using string distances.
translation.usage: amatch(x, table, nomatch=None, matchNA=True, method=None, useBytes=False, weight=(1, 1, 1, 1), maxDist=0.1, q=1, p=0, bt=0, nthread=1)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: String or list of strings to match. None is a missing string.

arguments.name: table
arguments.text: String or list of strings to search in.

arguments.name: nomatch
arguments.text: Value when no match is found; None is missing like R NA_integer_.

arguments.name: matchNA
arguments.text: When true, missing x matches missing table entries like R match.

arguments.name: method
arguments.text: osa, lv, dl, hamming, lcs, qgram, cosine, jaccard, jw, or soundex. Omitted means osa.

arguments.name: useBytes
arguments.text: Compare UTF-8 bytes instead of Unicode code points.

arguments.name: weight
arguments.text: Edit weights for osa, dl, lv, or jw.

arguments.name: maxDist
arguments.text: Maximum distance for a match; must be positive.

arguments.name: q
arguments.text: q-gram size for qgram, cosine, and jaccard.

arguments.name: p
arguments.text: Jaro-Winkler prefix factor when method is jw.

arguments.name: bt
arguments.text: Winkler boost threshold for jw.

arguments.name: nthread
arguments.text: Checked and unused.

translation.details: Delegates to the shared amatch implementation used by ain. Returns 1-based indices as integers in a list; None marks missing nomatch or no match when nomatch is None.
translation.value: A list of int values (or None), one per element of x.
